# Social Smiths

> Social Smiths is a creative marketing agency in Mumbai (Ghatkopar West) that works only with real estate and hospitality brands. We provide cinematic property video production, social media management, and influencer campaign management on a monthly retainer. The agency is led by Brendan Dsouza — a Mumbai real estate cinematographer and creator behind @shotbybrendan_ (143K+ followers), named Mid-Day's Emerging Real Estate Influencer 2026 — alongside co-founder Prerit Singh.

## What we do
- Real estate marketing agency in Mumbai for developers, brokers and hospitality brands
- Cinematic property video: walkthroughs, drone, lifestyle films, vertical reels
- Social media management: strategy, content calendars, reels, captions
- Influencer marketing: end-to-end creator campaigns for property launches
- Launch and lead-generation content for new project sales

## Who we serve
- Real estate developers running project launches
- Brokers and channel partners needing ongoing content and reels
- Hospitality brands across Mumbai, Thane and Navi Mumbai
